player_intent: The operator holds the equipped firearm naturally with both hands; the right hand grips the pistol grip, the left hand cups the foregrip without floating or clipping, and elbows bend anatomically during idle, movement, aiming, and firing.
acceptance_rule: The canonical player loads the standard 68-bone humanoid skeleton with native TwoBoneIK3D support-hand solving to the weapon-local foregrip target and UpperChest elbow pole; trigger and foregrip contact errors remain within 0.5 cm, elbow angles remain within 30 to 160 degrees, and upper-body combat fire and reload one-shots blend over moving legs.

nodes.role: Owns the 68-bone humanoid skeleton and native modifier stack at 1.0 scale.
Solves left upper arm, lower arm, and hand to the weapon's LHikTarget.
Aligns the left wrist rotation with the weapon's foregrip orientation.
Maintains natural anatomical elbow outward bias as the torso rotates and breathes.
Parents the equipped weapon root directly to the right hand palm.

must_not_change: SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority
server muzzle, shot, ballistics, damage, and networking authority
visual_check: Boot res://main.tscn. Confirm the operator holds the rifle firmly with both hands at the chest; walk in all 8 directions and confirm the left hand stays locked to the foregrip and elbows stay natural without twisting.
